Attribution per the earlier note's warning that one tree-wide count lets an improvement hide a regression elsewhere: measured on a pristine HEAD worktree at 87 and 82 with only addons/mrp replaced, the per-module finding lists differing by exactly one line -- the removal of mrp's 5. Measured with the requirements-dev.txt ruff from the repo root, where a bare 'addons/' is the bundled addons and the config that sets max-complexity is in scope; a 'git archive' export is NOT a valid baseline here, it drops ruff.toml and ruff then falls back to its own default.
